762040601.text: Let that bird <color=#00E1FFFF>walk the field</color> at leisure, while plants thrive atop the <color=#00E1FFFF>plinth</color>.

762040201.text: Nicole...! Weird, she's not here either...

762040202.text: Are you in my studio already? Did you notice my flower collection? I've been growing samples I collected from all over the world.

762040203.text: *sigh* I'm afraid I can't tear myself away right now. I've opened a stall in Fontaine selling sculptures.

762040204.text: Uhm... Do you want us to help?

762040205.text: No, thanks. This is my only chance to put pen to paper, even if I'm mostly just writing down numbers...

762040206.text: But I know it's not often you get the time to visit, so feel free to start without me.

762040207.text: By the way, I left you a scroll. I think I put it next to a statue of a finch near the west wall. Why don't you see if you can find it?

762040209.text: Then let my silent guide help you on your way... Good luck!

762040301.text: Congratulations! Now, let me take a look... Mhm, good job!

762040302.text: Unlike the current Witch's Garden, I stayed in this shrine when I was still an angel. This was my home for quite some time.

762040303.text: So many angels! It looks like you were super popular, Nicole!

762040304.text: I don't want to blow my own trumpet, but everyone used to love listening to my stories — especially the ones about living among humans, sending them omens, and guiding them to build great civilizations.

762040305.text: Every time I got to a good bit, the other angels would stop what they were doing and hold their breaths, hanging onto my every word. You couldn't hear so much as a harp string tremble or a paintbrush scratch on the surface of a canvas...

762040306.text: And then, the interwoven colors and hues would bloom. There would be music and light, illuminating everything in its golden splendor — a rapture of jubilation and joy.

762040308.text: Oh, it was, Paimon... It was.

762040309.text: Even though those wonderful days are gone, life remains full of happy surprises.

762040310.text: Wait a second... Someone actually had the gall to steal my sculptures while I was reading my newspaper? Oh, that's it for you, my foolish little friend! I'm going to guide you all the way to the Fortress of Meropide!

762049901.text: Paimon thought Nicole would be waiting for us inside. Isn't she home today?

762049902.text: It looks like this door can be pushed open. Do you think she's inside one of her rooms? We should go in and take a look.
